def fc_ets(train, h=3, trend=None, seasonal='mul'):
    fit=ExponentialSmoothing(train, trend=trend, seasonal=seasonal, seasonal_periods=12 if seasonal else None, damped_trend=(trend is not None), initialization_method='estimated').fit(optimized=True)
    return fit.forecast(h).iloc[-1]
